app.name: Filmnacht
setup.title: Set up your instance
setup.intro: This account becomes the instance admin. Pick the timezone your movie nights happen in.
setup.error.name: Please enter a display name of up to 60 characters.
setup.error.timezone: Please pick a timezone from the list.
setup.error.done: This instance is already set up.
auth.username_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. This is what you sign in with.
auth.display_name_hint: Change this any time. It does not have to be unique.
auth.error.username: Pick a username of 3 to 32 characters, using only letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
auth.error.username_taken: That username is already taken. If it's yours, sign in instead.
auth.error.password: Your password needs to be between 8 and 200 characters.
auth.error.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
groups.title: Your groups
groups.name: Group name
groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one, or open an invite link a friend sent you.
groups.error.name: Please enter a group name of up to 60 characters.
error.401: You need to be signed in to see this.
error.403: You do not have permission to do that.
invite.created: Send this link to your friends. It works for 7 days and for up to 12 people.
invite.join_as: You are signed in as {name}. Join this group as yourself.
invite.have_account: Already have an account? Sign in instead.
invite.invalid: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
invite.error.name: Please enter a display name of up to 60 characters.
invite.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
profile.title: Profile
profile.login_link_hint: Open this link on another device to sign in there. Anyone who has it can sign in as you, so share it only with yourself. Save it somewhere safe: it is the only way back in if you forget your password, and revealing a replacement needs that password.
profile.reveal_password: Current password, to reveal your login link
profile.reveal_warning: Revealing needs your password. It generates a new link and signs you out everywhere else — only this device stays signed in.
profile.username_fixed: This is what you sign in with. It cannot be changed.
profile.email_hint: Optional. Used only to reset your password, and only if this instance can send mail.
profile.password_changed: Password changed. Every other device has been signed out, and your old personal login link no longer works — reveal a new one below with your new password, and save it.
profile.error.current_password: That is not your current password.
profile.error.email: That does not look like an email address.
profile.error.email_taken: That email address is already in use on this instance.
profile.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.invalid: This login link is not valid any more. Reveal a new one on a device where you are still signed in.
login.title: Sign in
login.failed: That username and password do not match.
login.forgot: Forgotten your password? A personal login link you saved earlier still signs you in. Otherwise the reset form can email you a link, if you saved an address and this instance can send mail — and if it cannot, ask whoever runs this instance.
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.sent: If that address belongs to an account here, a reset link is on its way. It expires in an hour.
reset.no_mail: This instance cannot send email, so there is no reset link to send. A personal login link you saved earlier still signs you in — otherwise ask whoever runs this instance to generate a recovery link for you.
reset.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
reset.error.email: That does not look like an email address.
reset.choose_hint: Setting a new password signs out every other device, and any personal login link you had saved stops working.
reset.invalid: This reset link is not valid any more. Request a new one.
admin.title: Instance administration
admin.recover_hint: For a member who forgot their password and cannot receive email. Hand the link over in person or through a channel you trust — it sets a new password and signs out every device they were using.
admin.recovered: Recovery link for {name}. It works once and expires in an hour. This is the only time it is shown.
admin.error.no_such_member: No account with that id. Reload the page — the list may be out of date.
pool.title: The pool
pool.empty: No films yet. Add the first one.
pool.error.duplicate: That film is already in the pool.
pool.error.cap_reached: You have used all your suggestions. Withdraw one first.
pool.error.not_found: That suggestion is not yours, or no longer exists.
pool.error.already_drawn: That film has already been drawn and cannot be withdrawn.
add.title: Add a film to {group}
add.search_none: Nothing found. Type it in below instead.
add.search_disabled: Search is off because this instance has no TMDB API key. You can still add films by hand.
add.search_failed: Search is unavailable right now. You can still add films by hand.
add.note_hint: Shown to the group only after the draw, max 200 characters.
nights.title: Movie nights
nights.error.when: That is not a date and time this instance can use.
nights.error.not_owner: Only the group's owner can do that.
night.drawn_one: Only one film could be drawn, so {title} it is — no dice were rolled.
night.drawn_former: {title}, suggested by a member who has since left.
night.error.no_candidates: Nobody has a film that can be drawn right now.
night.error.not_scheduled: This night is not waiting for a draw.
night.error.redraw_used: This night has already been drawn again once.
night.error.sole_suggestion: There is only one film in the pool, so drawing again would return it. Add another suggestion first.
night.mark_watched_hint: Nothing marks a night watched automatically. Until somebody does, this film does not count towards anyone's turn.
night.error.not_drawn: No film has been drawn for this night yet.
night.hidden: The film stays a surprise until the night starts.
night.redraw_hint: One re-draw per night. Both results stay on record.
night.error.reason: Say briefly why you are drawing again.
night.error.cannot_cancel: This night can no longer be cancelled.
night.error.response: That is not an answer this page offers.
ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.locked: Scores are revealed, so yours is final.
ratings.opens: Rating opens when the night ends: {when}.
ratings.error.window: Rating is not open for this night.
ratings.error.locked: Scores are revealed, so yours can no longer change.
ratings.error.comment: That comment is longer than 500 characters.
ratings.error.no_ratings: Nobody has rated yet, so there is nothing to reveal.
ratings.error.not_found: You have no rating to withdraw.
